component.name: Open Voice Input Linux
Open Voice Input Linux
component.summary: Native inline IBus voice input for Linux
在当前光标处原生输入文字的 Linux 语音输入法

description.p: Open Voice Input Linux sends live speech recognition text to the focused IBus input context without using the clipboard or simulated paste.

This Ubuntu 24.04 preview supports adaptive terminology corrections, per-utterance microphone selection, and optional user-owned ASR data collection. Recognition uses the user's account for the selected online provider; Volcengine remains the default and real-key-validated path.
The native GTK4 client is intentionally small and does not bundle an Electron runtime or local speech model.
Open Voice Input Linux 将实时语音识别结果直接写入当前 IBus 输入位置， 不依赖剪贴板或模拟粘贴。
当前 Ubuntu 24.04 预览版支持术语纠错学习、逐句动态选择麦克风和可选的 用户自有 ASR 数据收集；在线识别使用用户所选服务的自有账号，火山引擎 仍是默认且已用真实 Key 验收的路径。
原生 GTK4 客户端保持轻量，不捆绑 Electron 运行时或本地语音模型。
